contentPattern.structure: row-per-category-label (All + N categories) controlling a sibling cards grid

behavior.controls: the next sibling .cards block in the same section
behavior.matchAttribute: data-categories (space-separated category class names on each card li)
behavior.note: Unlike the vanilla tabs block (one content panel per tab), this variant renders only a category filter bar and toggles the visibility (hidden) of cards in a sibling cards block. This avoids nesting a cards block inside tab panels (David's Model: blocks must not be nested).

suitableFor: category/tag filtering over a card grid
section-landing pages that filter a repeatable list of items
any page where a shared item grid is filtered by non-exclusive categories
notSuitableFor: true tabbed content where each tab has distinct, independent panel content (use the vanilla tabs block)
filtering when items are not authored as a sibling cards block
